name: MediHisab
what: A Bangla pharmacy app for Bangladeshi shop owners: sales, stock by batch, expiry warnings and the customer credit book (বাকি) on an Android phone.
hard_part: Expiry is tracked per stock batch: the server refuses a sale from an expired batch and warns 30 days ahead. Dues and payments are idempotent by operation id, and business days, invoice dates and ledger dates follow Dhaka time while the server stores UTC.
status: Play closed test · API live · no paying shops yet
